purpose: Leakage-controlled analyst-network model comparison for the broad-S&P event-sleeve mechanism using one frozen model-ready run. Only eligible training rows are used for fitting and only eligible validation rows are scored; the sealed test split is never predicted or scored.
scope_note: This runner validates the broad-S&P event-sleeve mechanism and is not the final AI-universe model. A later point-in-time AI-universe validation is required.

feature_rules.all_52: all model_features.csv columns except sample_id; the frozen run must contain exactly 52 numeric feature columns

event_model.purpose: predict the actual mean target of each training event

within_event_residual_model.purpose: predict target minus the actual training-event mean

hyperparameters.two_stage_ridge_grid: cartesian product of ridge_alphas for event_alpha and residual_alpha

preprocessing.imputer: SimpleImputer(strategy=median) fitted separately inside each training fold and again on full eligible training data for final models
preprocessing.ridge: StandardScaler after the training-fold median imputer
preprocessing.missing_values: target missingness is never imputed; feature missingness is handled only by the declared training-fitted median imputer
preprocessing.outliers: no winsorization, clipping, forward fill, backward fill, interpolation or zero fill

weights.rule: equal total weight per eligible source event within every row-level fit or scoring sample
weights.row_weight_formula: 1 / number of eligible rows in the same event
weights.event_model: one row per event, therefore unit weight per event

selection.network_family_scope: nominate exactly one of analyst_ridge, analyst_hgb and two_stage_ridge from training-only rolling CV

validation_roles.exploratory: training_weighted_mean, simple_rec_weighted_signal, receiver_only_ridge and non-nominee model families

evaluation.cv_scope: training split only with 2018/2019/2020 rolling training-only folds; each fold trains only before its validation year and purges rows with exit_session on or after the fold validation start

bootstrap.statistic: mean paired event Spearman delta across complete nominee/context event pairs; sample announcement-month blocks with replacement

test_policy.target: test target value columns must be NaN and are checked only for the seal; no non-empty test target may be used
test_policy.prediction: do not fit, score or predict any test row
test_policy.output: validation_predictions.csv contains validation rows only and has no test prediction column

output.model_files: one joblib artifact per declared model, including a transparent specification artifact for the deterministic signal and training mean
